buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses GENERAL TERMS & CONDITIONS The terms & conditions for hiring the D.G. Set are as under: 1. The terms and conditions along with the instructions will form part of the tende r to be submitted by the tenderer to LIC of India, herein termed as Corporation. 2. There should not be any deviation in terms and conditions as laid down in the B ID documents.

3. Rates are to be quoted through GeM Portal for running the D.G.Set 7.50 KVA, CPCB-IV) on the basis of estimated bid value (27170*36= 97 8120.00 with GST) i.e. Total 36 months value and payment will be done on monthly basis including diesel and Rental charges, for each ra ting of D.G. Set complete with all accessories on hire basis. 4. The operator provided by the supplier, should possess the requisite & valid Li cense, for running D.G. Set. if required by local or any other govt. authorities. 5. All cost for maintenance and servicing of the generator including the cost of sp are parts and periodical replacement of Mobil oil, diesel are to be borne by the D.G.set contractor. The D.G. Set should be maintained properly to keep th ese in satisfactory running condition at all times for supplying emergency pow er for a load at least 90% of rated output of respective generators normal loa ding will be 75% + 5% upward variation . 6. The permission of statutory authorities towards installation of D.G set, will be o btained by the supplier /Vendor /Contractor of D.G set at their own cost. 7. The arrangements for providing exhaust pipeline of the D.G. Set, as per require ment & specification of Statutory Authorities, will be made by the contractor at their own cost. 8. Mending of any damage caused to the LIC property during loading, unloading o f the D.G. Set in LIC premises at the time of installation or taking out D.G set fr om LIC premises will be done by the contractor to original finish, at their cost. 9. Contractor shall be solely responsible for Repairing & Mending of any damage due to natural Disaster i.e. Flood, Earthquakes, Hurricanes, cyclone, storms etc. 10.The successful bidder should install and commission the New D.G. Set in LIC pr emises within 30 (Thirty) days from the date of awarding the contract, If D.G. set is not supplied &installed within the stipulated period from the date of acc eptance letter, L.I.C. of India reserve the right to cancel the order and forfeit th e E.M.D./ S.D. 11. 30 days period is given to vendor for installation of New D.G set from the date of awarding the contract. If the D.G set is installed by the vendor beyond 30 da ys; the losses (if any) shall be borne by the vendor and amount of losses shall b e recovered from the vendor’s monthly bill payment. (a) Here; losses means rate of existing tender minus L-1 rate of new tender

(monthly rent +Over time+ Waiting time charges) (b) Calculation of losses : (Difference of rates x No of days delayed beyond 30d ays) 12.Electricity Duty, if any, payable to the State Govt., depending on running hours of the D.G. Set shall be borne by the contractor. Installation of the energy mete r with its calibration and registration with the Statutory Authority shall be done by the contractor at their cost. 13.The contract shall remain in force initially for a period of three years from the d ate of installation and satisfactory commissioning of the New D.G. Set at site, which may be extended further for another two year on mutual consent & perfo rmance of the Vendor, on same terms & conditions. The contract may be renew ed for further period at mutually agreed rates / charges and keeping other term s & conditions unchanged, depending on satisfactory services rendered by the generator supplier and requirement of the office, on expiry of existing agree ment vendor has to continue the services at existing Terms & conditio ns till the Installation of New DG Set. Extension /renewal of contract is not a right of vendor .It will be at sole discretion of LIC. 14.However, the contract is subject to termination at any time if the services are n ot found satisfactory or for any other reason whatsoever. LIC of India may termi nate the contract after giving one calendar month notice if the service of DG se t is not required. 15.In case of any major break-down of D.G. Set requiring repairing time for more t han one day, an alternative interim arrangement will be made by the generator provider immediately by providing a substitute generator of adequate capacity at no extra cost. For non-functioning of the D.G. Set or in the event of failure on the part of the generator supplier to provide an alternative interim generator of adequate capacity, within one day during power failure / load shedding, penalty deduction shall be made based on OT rate for running of DG set beyond normal hours and if the same is not restored within 24 hours, Corporati on will be free to hire another DG set from the market at the risk and cost of co ntractor, limited to double the amount quoted by the contractor. 16.The successful bidder will have to execute an Agreement with LIC of India, in Non - judicial stamp paper of Rs 100/ , and as per the draft of Agreement to be provided by the LIC of India, within seven days period from the date of issue of work order for commencement of the work. If agreement is not executed the n No payment will be made.

17.The deployment of operator for running the generator is must and should comp ly with the Labour Legislation Act. and Minimum wage Act of Govt. of India and t he State Govt. 18.The contractor will have to remove the D.G. Set from the LIC premises wit hin 07 (Seven) days from the date of termination or closure of the contract at t heir cost , else demurrage charges @ 1000/- (Rupees One thousand only) per d ay will be levied by the LIC of India, on the contractor. 19.The D.G. set shall have to be run in the event of load shedding / powe r cut / breakdown / single phasing / erratic power supply from supply c ompany/any other reason on all working days. Normal working hours o n all working days shall be from Monday to Friday (except holiday if a ny) 9.30 AM to 6.30 PM 20. If the D.G set has to run during office hours due to failure of office changeover , office transformer, office UPS, cable etc. or any kind of fault from office inspite of power supply company, the payment for running of DG set in the per iod shall be made as per payment term & condition point no 06 i.e. 1.88 Lit/H rs during office hours & 1.62 Lit/hrs beyond the office hours. 21.Please note that new D G set shall comprise Diesel Engine of Kirloskar Green / Cummins India /Ashok- Leland / Greaves/Mahindra and Mahindra Ltd, coupled w ith Alternator of Stamdford / Crompton / Kirloskar O.E.Ms ie Jakson / Bhaskar/Su dhir /OEMs/TATA etc will only be accepted. The approval of make of Engine, Alternator & Enclosure must be obtained well before procurement. If the tender er wishes to procure the D.G.Set other than approved make, they must submit t he proposal along with copy of certification as mentioned & obtain approval of S r. Divisional Manager well before procurement of D.G. Set. If at any stage it is fo und that DG set provided is not of our approved make, LIC reserves the right to ask the contractor to remove the DG set & provide new DG set as per approved makes 22.The successful Trenderer has to submit copies of invoices/bills after p rocurement of D.G.Set . The name, address & phone no. of service cen tre shall also be mentioned. 23.The quoted rate for running the D.G set on monthly hire basis shall be inclusive of cost of DG set installation, operation (including operator) , cost of diesel pric e prevailing in the market at the date of opening of tender, lubricant, maintena nce, tools, security, transportation etc. complete required for D G set operation, Please note that any variation ( Increases / Decreases ) in the price of diesel will be considered for payment / recovery as per the Govt. notification issued for die

sel price. 24. A Log book shall be maintained by contractor’s operator in the Branch premis es for recording the daily running of DG set including over time which should be countersigned by authorized representative of LIC. 25.Contractor will be responsible for payment of applicable taxes to concerned aut horities. Liability towards service tax for contractor and employer shall be in ac cordance with relevant provision of the recent finance act or any amendment is sued by concerned Authorities. Deduction of I.Tax , Work contract Tax / any oth er taxes from bills will be done as per government rules . Any other taxes, duti es, levies (if any) taken by Central / state government /local authorities etc are i ncluded in rates & nothing extra shall be paid on any account. 26.Bill shall be submitted in triplicate in the first week of the following month alon g with the Xerox copy of Logbook and original Log Book for certification and settlement of the bill. The payment will be made after deducting the Income Ta x and Works contract Tax etc. on monthly basis at source as per the rules from the running bills. No payment will be made until the Agreement is executed. 27.If required Tenderer has to submit necessary approval from pollution control b oard / Directorate of electrical safety without any extra cost to LICI. Sound and pollution level shall be maintained within standard parameters. 28.Successful tenderer has to obtain policies for each D.G.set to cover T.P., Fire a nd W.C. Insurance cover of reasonable amount (Min Rs.50000/-) for each policy (as mentioned in LOI/Acceptance letter), which shall remain in force till the cont ract period and extension if granted. No payment shall be released, if the i nsurance lapses during contract period. “Penalty of not taking timely extension of expired policies- The date of submitting the renewed insu rance policy, if any will be 15 working days prior to the last date of ex piry of the existing policy, failing which LICI may insure/renew insuran ce and apply penal cost on the contractor i.e. premium Charges plus R s.10,000/- as Admin Charges and Rs.25,000/- as penalty.” 29.Security Deposit: Successful Bidder will also have to remit a Security Deposit b y DD / Pay Order / Banker’s Cheque for an amount equal to 3% of three year’s e stimated hiring charges as per tender excluding E.M.D within 15 days from the date of issue of acceptance letter. Work order for commencement of the work w ill be issued separately within seven days after your remitting the requisite Sec urity Deposit. Please note that the Security Deposit will not bear any interes t and the same will be refunded to you within 45 (Forty five) days after the term ination of the contract.

30.Tenderers are requested to visit to the site of work before quoting their rates. 31.The essential service electrical load shall be connected to D. G. set. 32. The arrangements for providing accessories like cables, earthling (as per IE rul e for three phase 2 for neutral & 2 for body) Plate /Chemical earthing & for singl e phase (one for body & one for Neutal earthing)), foundation etc., Change ov er switch) if required), will made by the Contractor /Vendor at their own cost. 33.Unauthorized supply of power to other agency / firms from the D.G.set installed at our premises if any are found , penal action will be taken against the vendor as deemed fit by LIC. 34.LICI shall not be responsible for any injury partial or permanent or death of any worker at site due to accident or any other reasons or by personal negligence of the staff of the contractor. LIC of India, will remain indemnified by the contrac tor on this account. 35.The firm shall be fully responsible for any liability / compensation in case of any accident or otherwise any untoward incident at his own risk for the staff depute d by the firm and LICI shall not give any compensation. 36. First Aid box shall be arranged by the contractor at site of work at their cost. 37.Timing of office may change according to the LICI’s requirement. 38.The contractor shall not sublet the contract to any other party / contractor. 39.Contractor shall be solely responsible for payment of wages / salaries and allow ances to his personnel that might become applicable under any Government or der. LIC of India shall have no liability whatsoever in any manner. 40.For running the generator beyond the schedule hours, permission in writing sh all be taken from the LIC of India and a copy of the same shall be produced whil e claiming the overtime charges. 41.LICI will provide suitable space for installation of D.G.set, but other infrastructu res diesel tank etc. to be arranged by the vendor. 42.The following tests shall be performed at manufacture’s outlet prior to packing & dispatch to site:- a. Load test at full load 50% load, 75% and 110% overload. b. Fuel consumption at full load, 75% load, 50% load and 25% load. c. Other routine test as per IS / BS on alternator, exciter and AVR. Original co pies of the test certificates shall be submitted to LIC of India

d. Noise level measurement. 43.In case of dispute, the matter shall be settled mutually, failing which the decisi on of the Sr.DM, LIC of India, shall be final and binding on the bidders. All legal disputes related to contract will be only under the jurisdiction of Court of Bareill y city only. 44.LIC of India, reserves the right to accept any tender or to reject any or all tende rs at his sole discretion without assigning reasons whatsoever. The tender inviti ng authority does not bind to accept the lowest tender. a. If the performance of running of D.G. set is not found satisfactory at any ti me during contract period, or any other reason, LIC of India reserves the ri ght to terminate the contract by serving one calendar month notice. b. If contractor wish to remove the D.G.set, from LIC Branch /D.O. they shall need to serve three calendar months advance notice to LIC of India.. 45.Sound & pollution level shall be maintained with in the prescribed limits as per Govt norms. No payment shall be maid by LIC on this account. 46.The D.G set should be maintained properly to keep those in satisfactory runnin g condition at all time. 47.Vendor should provide Two automatic hours meter, one at D.G set’s end and ot her at Change over end i.e. under office building with its calibration and registr ation with the Statutory Authority shall be done by the contractor at their cost 48.The D.G set should run smoothly on full load for 10 Hrs without any breakdown and at least 90% of rated out put 49.All electrical parameters like frequency, voltage, should be compactable with lo cal electricity Supply Company. Other conditions · Exhaust piping needs to be done to ensure that exhaust gases are guided out o f the D.G. Set room without any leakage inside, to ensure proper temperature in the room and to meet pollution board requirements. It is recommended to have ‘A’ class M.S. pipe or a fabricated pipe to minimize overall pipeline weight. · Generally exhaust piping should be designed such, so that backpressure for tot al system does not exceed 3 inches of mercury. · Minimum bends (max.4 from exhaust main feed) should be there in pipeline. · Exhaust pipe must be supported securely.

· Exhaust pipe inside the room should be lagged with asbestos rope/glass wool, a luminum sheet cladding. · Pipeline should be away from combustible material. · The orientation of Exhaust pipe shall be towards the normal wind direction. · Rain cap should be provided. · Flanges should be used for connecting flexible pipe, silencer etc.& asbestos she et, gasket packing should be used in between the flanges. · Silencer should be located in the exhaust line with necessary supports either wi thin the D.G. Set room in horizontal position or vertically along the outside wall o f D. G. Set room. · Common exhaust pipe for multiple D. G. Set shall not be allowed · Exhaust pipe size shall be as recommended by the D. G. Set Manufacturer. · On bidding in GeM Portal for this tender will be considered as the ven dor agree and will comply all the terms & conditions laid down in bid do cuments. Sr. Divisional Manager
